title: Cyberwave Controller Runtime Target
description: Where and how a controller policy runs for one runtime kind: whether it is enabled, the backend that executes it, and the contracts it reads and writes. Resolved by the backend from a policy's metadata and returned in controller setup views.

enabled.description: False when this runtime kind is switched off for the policy.

runtime_kind.description: Whether the policy drives a real robot or a simulated one.

backend.description: The runtime backend that executes the policy (for example `edge` or a simulation backend name).

adapter.description: The execution adapter, when the policy needs one.

source_type.description: The source_type the runtime publishes under (see source_type.envelope.v1).

safety_level.description: The safety classification of the target, when one applies.

input_contract.description: The contract id of what the policy consumes.

output_contract.description: The contract id of what the policy produces.
